positioning.headline: Architect. Prove. Ship. Watch. We ship software.
positioning.summary: AI-native architecture and turnkey engineering studio. Principal-led system architecture and deterministic AI pipelines, with elastic partner engineering capacity.
positioning.model: Principal-led, elastic capacity: every engagement starts with the Principal Architect setting the C4 architecture, domain contracts and workflow.ai.yml CI gates. Core work is synthesized inside APSW Labs; multi-team scale-out is staffed by vetted partner engineering squads working inside those gates.
positioning.methodology: Indaba (@indaba/engine) and a single workflow.ai.yml: a declared graph of steps behind exit-code guards, multi-agent councils, CI drift checks.

delivery_model.name: Principal Wedge & Blueprint
delivery_model.description: C4 boundaries, domain contracts, security isolation and repository CI guardrails defined personally by the Principal Architect.

delivery_model.name: Autonomous Core Synthesis
delivery_model.description: Core modules, data pipelines and MVPs synthesized and verified with @indaba/engine and multi-agent councils.

delivery_model.name: Elastic Partner Scale-Out
delivery_model.description: Squads of 4-8 engineers for long-term expansion, mobile apps or 24/7 SLA, working in the pre-configured workflow.ai.yml repository under automated CI gates.

engagement_tracks.name: 10-Day Architecture & AI Readiness Blueprint
engagement_tracks.description: Codebase and microservice audit, C4 target blueprints, security and isolation review, executable workflow.ai.yml roadmap.

engagement_tracks.name: Turnkey Core MVP / Module Sprint
engagement_tracks.description: Fixed-scope delivery of a complete MVP, high-load telemetry backend or 10M-row Gridwright Pro interface, with over 90% automated contract tests and Docker / Cloud IaC.

engagement_tracks.name: Deterministic AI Factory Setup
engagement_tracks.description: The engineering standard behind Gridwright installed into the client repository: workflow.ai.yml tracks, multi-agent review councils, CI drift guards, senior engineering playbooks.

engagement_tracks.name: Full-Scale Platform & Dedicated Squads
engagement_tracks.description: Enterprise product development, legacy modernization or dedicated squads (Java 21, Symfony 8, React, Cloud/Data). Architected and gated by APSW Labs, scaled and staffed by vetted partner squads.

products.name: Gridwright
